rule: A lane says which District priority an outcome serves. It says what a partner works toward, never that the partner moves it, and it is never a score for a partner. Research credit comes only from the SPOTlight links file, by program model.

source.citation: Board of Education, School District of Philadelphia. Bylaw 003.1, Goals and Guardrails (adopted 29 June 2023, revised 19 October 2023).

guardrailDefinition.text: Guardrails: The nonnegotiable conditions that must exist in schools to support achieving the Goals.

goals.text: All students read on or above grade level
All students perform on or above grade level in math
All students graduate college and career ready

guardrails.text: Every school will be a safe, welcoming, and healthy place where students, staff, and community want to be and learn each day ... spaces with inclusive climates that provide students with access to robust social, emotional, and mental health supports
Every student will have a well-rounded education with co-curricular opportunities, including arts and athletics, integrated into the school experience.
Every parent and guardian will be welcomed and encouraged to be partners in their child’s school community.
Students' potential will not be limited by practices that perpetuate systemic racism and hinder student achievement.

source.note: The fourth guardrail concerns District practices that perpetuate systemic racism, not a student outcome, so no code is placed in it.

lanes.name: Names a SPOTlight indicator
lanes.description: The outcome is the subject of a District SPOTlight indicator: reading, math, science, attendance, graduation or the career and technical education industry test.

lanes.name: Steps toward an indicator
lanes.description: Research follows this outcome to a SPOTlight indicator: grades and on-track status, engagement, persistence, mindsets, suspensions, school readiness.

lanes.name: Board goal: graduate college and career ready
lanes.description: Serves the Board goal of graduating college and career ready. Apart from graduation, the SPOTlight has no measure for it.

quote.text: All students graduate college and career ready

lanes.name: Guardrail: safe, welcoming and healthy schools
lanes.description: Valued under the Board guardrail for safe, welcoming and healthy schools with social, emotional and mental health supports.

quote.text: Every school will be a safe, welcoming, and healthy place where students, staff, and community want to be and learn each day ... spaces with inclusive climates that provide students with access to robust social, emotional, and mental health supports

lanes.name: Guardrail: a well-rounded education
lanes.description: Valued under the Board guardrail for a well-rounded education with co-curricular opportunities, including arts and athletics.

quote.text: Every student will have a well-rounded education with co-curricular opportunities, including arts and athletics, integrated into the school experience.

lanes.name: Guardrail: parents and guardians as partners
lanes.description: Valued under the Board guardrail that welcomes parents and guardians as partners in their child's school community.

quote.text: Every parent and guardian will be welcomed and encouraged to be partners in their child’s school community.

lanes.name: Family outcome, valued on its own terms
lanes.description: A result for families and caregivers: well-being, skills and basic needs. It is not tested against student indicators.

lanes.name: Condition for quality, not a student outcome
lanes.description: A result for staff, programs, access or systems. Testing it against student indicators would be a category error.
